en: A colored vintage postcard showing a tranquil river scene with small wooden rowing boats and people on the water. Lush green trees line both banks, with low hills in the background and a small bridge crossing the river in the middle distance. Barrels and rural structures are visible along the shore. At the top is a French caption identifying the place as the Sweet Waters of Europe near the Bosphorus.
